meta.title: Agre Jobs — Jobs in agriculture, food and gastronomy
meta.description: Jobs shaping the future of food in Türkiye and beyond. Openings in agriculture, food systems and gastronomy.

hero.headline: Jobs shaping the future of food in Türkiye and beyond.
hero.lead: Put your skills to work for the future of this land.
hero.description: Meet the organizations, ventures and projects working on the future of food in Türkiye and the region, and adding value to local production. Explore jobs and career opportunities.

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.subtitle: From field to table, the whole food ecosystem.

cta.talentBody: Sector-specific roles from agronomy to culinary R&D, export to food tech. Every listing links to its original source.
cta.employerBody: Reach mission-driven candidates in agriculture, food and gastronomy. Free for cooperatives, NGOs and small producers.
